API ReferenceZscaler Cloud & Branch Connector APIDNS Control Forwarding RuleEc Rule Z Resource Get Ec DNS Rules
Ec Rule Z Resource Get Ec DNS Rules
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/ecRules/ecDns

Retrieves the list of DNS forwarding rules.

⚠ This API endpoint is accessible only via OneAPI.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
ruleName
string

The search string used to match against the rule name.

ruleOrder
string

The search string used to match against the rule order.

ruleDescription
string

The search string used to match against the rule description.

ruleAction
string

Possible values: [ALLOW, BLOCK, REDIR_REQ, REDIR_RES, REDIR_ZPA, REDIR_REQ_DOH, REDIR_REQ_KEEP_SENDER, REDIR_REQ_TCP, REDIR_REQ_UDP, BLOCK_WITH_RESPONSE, BLOCK_WITH_EUN]

Specifies the rule action.

location
string

The search string used to match against the locations or sublocations used in rule configurations.

page
int32

Specifies the page offset.

Default value: 1
pageSize
int32

Specifies the page size. The default size is 50.

Default value: 50
sortBy
string

The rule parameter by which the list must be sorted.

Default value: order
sortOrder
string

Possible values: [asc, desc, ruleExecution]

Specifies whether the list must be sorted by ascending or descending rule order or by rule processing order.

Default value: ruleExecution
Responses
​
default

default response

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
accessControl
string

Access permission to the rule available for the current user.

Possible values: [NONE, READ_ONLY, READ_WRITE]

action
string

Action triggered when the traffic aligns with the policy.

Possible values: [ALLOW, BLOCK, REDIR_REQ, REDIR_RES, REDIR_ZPA, REDIR_REQ_DOH, REDIR_REQ_KEEP_SENDER, REDIR_REQ_TCP, REDIR_REQ_UDP, BLOCK_WITH_RESPONSE, BLOCK_WITH_EUN]

blockResponseCode
string

Possible values: [FORMERR, SERVFAIL, NXDOMAIN, NOTIMP, REFUSED]

defaultRule
boolean

Indicates whether the rule is a default rule.
